20260430_0001_key: Why does the sky appear blue during the day?
20260430_0001_answer: Because shorter blue wavelengths in sunlight scatter much more in every direction when they hit air molecules — a phenomenon called Rayleigh scattering!
20260430_0001_opt1: The ocean reflects up onto the sky
20260430_0001_opt2: Oxygen in the air is naturally blue
20260430_0001_opt3: Blue wavelengths scatter the most in the atmosphere
20260430_0001_opt4: The ozone layer is tinted blue
20260430_0002_key: At about 20 °C, sound travels through air at roughly what speed?
20260430_0002_answer: The speed of sound in 20 °C air is about 343 m/s, increasing roughly 0.6 m/s for every additional degree Celsius!
20260430_0003_key: If a substance has a pH of 7, what does that tell us about it?
20260430_0003_answer: A pH of 7 means the substance is neither acidic nor basic — it is neutral. Pure water sits at exactly pH 7!
20260430_0004_key: How is Newton's Second Law of Motion expressed as an equation?
20260430_0004_answer: Force equals mass times acceleration, written as F = ma. It's one of the most fundamental equations in classical mechanics!
20260430_0005_key: Which optical tool splits white light into the colors of the rainbow?
20260430_0005_answer: A prism bends each color of light by a different amount thanks to varying refractive indices, separating white light into its spectrum. Newton famously used one to study light!
20260430_0006_key: Which protein in our body is responsible for carrying oxygen through the blood?
20260430_0006_answer: Hemoglobin lives inside red blood cells and uses iron to bind and transport oxygen. The iron is also why our blood looks red!
20260430_0007_key: What do we call the phase change when a liquid becomes a solid?
20260430_0007_answer: When a liquid turns into a solid, the process is called solidification (or freezing for water specifically) — releasing heat as it does so!
20260430_0008_key: Which empire is regarded as having the largest contiguous land territory in human history?
20260430_0008_answer: The Mongol Empire reached roughly 24 million km² in the 13th–14th centuries, the largest continuous land empire ever recorded!
20260430_0009_key: In which city is the ancient Roman amphitheater 'Colosseum' located?
20260430_0009_answer: The Colosseum stands in Rome, Italy, and once hosted up to 50,000 spectators at gladiator games!
20260430_0010_key: Which French king was executed by guillotine during the French Revolution?
20260430_0010_answer: Louis XVI was executed in January 1793, and his queen Marie Antoinette met the same fate later that year!
20260430_0011_key: Which country gave the Statue of Liberty in New York Harbor as a gift?
20260430_0011_answer: France gave the statue in 1886 to celebrate the 100th anniversary of American independence. It was sculpted by Frédéric Auguste Bartholdi!
20260430_0012_key: In what year did the Korean War break out?
20260430_0012_answer: The war began on June 25, 1950, when North Korean forces crossed the 38th parallel, and paused with an armistice on July 27, 1953!
20260430_0013_key: What is the era called when European explorers opened up sea routes to the wider world starting in the late 15th century?
20260430_0013_answer: The Age of Discovery (also called the Age of Exploration) spans roughly the 200 years around Columbus's 1492 voyage, when Europeans charted new ocean routes!
20260430_0014_key: Which single country has the most time zones?
20260430_0014_answer: Russia spans 11 time zones — Moscow and Kamchatka are 9 hours apart!
20260430_0015_key: On which continent is Vostok Station, where the lowest temperature on Earth was recorded?
20260430_0015_answer: Russia's Vostok Station sits in Antarctica and recorded -89.2 °C in 1983. Satellites have since detected even colder spots near -98 °C!
20260430_0016_key: What does India's Diwali festival celebrate?
20260430_0016_answer: Diwali is the 'festival of lights,' celebrating the triumph of light over darkness and good over evil. Homes glow with oil lamps and fireworks!
20260430_0017_key: What is enjoyed during the Japanese springtime tradition known as 'hanami'?
20260430_0017_answer: Hanami is the centuries-old custom of viewing cherry blossoms while picnicking under the trees, peaking in March and April!
20260430_0018_key: What is the capital of Saudi Arabia?
20260430_0018_answer: Riyadh is the capital, a desert metropolis in central Saudi Arabia with a population of around 7 million!
20260430_0019_key: In which country is Venice, the famous 'City of Water'?
20260430_0019_answer: Venice is in northeastern Italy, built on 118 small islands linked by around 400 bridges across its canals!
20260430_0020_key: Under Korean traffic law, at what blood alcohol concentration does license suspension begin?
20260430_0020_answer: Suspension begins at 0.03% BAC and revocation at 0.08%, after the 2019 'Yoon Chang-ho Law' tightened the limits!
20260430_0021_key: Under Korea's Labor Standards Act, what is the standard statutory work week?
20260430_0021_answer: The legal limit is 40 hours per week, with up to 12 additional overtime hours allowed by agreement, capping total work at 52 hours!
20260430_0022_key: Under Korea's Criminal Procedure Act, how is the statute of limitations set for crimes punishable by death, such as murder?
20260430_0022_answer: Since the 2015 amendment (often called the 'Tae-wan Law'), the statute of limitations does not apply to crimes punishable by death!
20260430_0023_key: How long is the term of the President of South Korea under the Constitution?
20260430_0023_answer: Article 70 sets the presidential term at five years with no re-election allowed — a single, non-renewable term!
20260430_0024_key: What is the name of The Economist's index that compares exchange rates using the price of a Big Mac?
20260430_0024_answer: The Big Mac Index, introduced by The Economist in 1986, gives a quick read on whether currencies are over- or undervalued via purchasing power parity!
20260430_0025_key: What do we call it when one country's currency loses value relative to others?
20260430_0025_answer: Depreciation makes exports cheaper abroad but pushes up the price of imports for the home country!
20260430_0026_key: In stock investing, what is a 'stop-loss'?
20260430_0026_answer: A stop-loss is a pre-set sell trigger designed to cap losses if the price drops to a certain level — a core risk management tool!
20260430_0026_opt1: Selling at a preset price to cap further losses
20260430_0026_opt2: Buying more shares as the price keeps rising
20260430_0026_opt4: Trading short-term to capture small gains
20260430_0027_key: What unconventional monetary policy involves a central bank purchasing large amounts of bonds to inject money into the economy?
20260430_0027_answer: Quantitative Easing (QE) is used when interest rates are already near zero, boosting liquidity by buying assets directly!
20260430_0028_key: When calling 119 to report a fire in Korea, what is the most important piece of information to give first?
20260430_0028_answer: Callers often forget the location under stress, so report the precise address first, then describe the situation, then any injuries!
20260430_0029_key: If you smell gas at home, what should you absolutely NOT do?
20260430_0029_answer: Flicking electrical switches can spark a gas explosion. Open windows, shut the gas valve, leave the house, then call 119 from outside!
20260430_0029_opt3: Flip a light switch on or off
20260430_0029_opt4: Get outside, then call for help
20260430_0030_key: What should you do first if your car catches fire while driving?
20260430_0030_answer: Pull over to a safe spot, get everyone out of the vehicle immediately, move well away, and only then call 119!
20260430_0030_opt1: Stop and get out of the car immediately
20260430_0030_opt3: Close all windows and keep driving
20260430_0031_key: When you find someone unconscious, what should you check first?
20260430_0031_answer: Check responsiveness and breathing first. If they are not breathing, call emergency services and start chest compressions immediately!
20260430_0031_opt1: Whether they are responsive and breathing
20260430_0032_key: What's an effective home tip for drying soaking-wet shoes quickly?
20260430_0032_answer: Stuffing crumpled newspaper inside the shoes pulls out moisture and helps them keep their shape. Swap the paper every hour or two for fastest drying!
20260430_0032_opt2: Place them directly on a hot radiator
20260430_0032_opt3: Leave them in direct sunlight for 6+ hours
20260430_0033_key: What's a quick way to soothe an itchy, swollen mosquito bite?
20260430_0033_answer: An ice pack works best — the cold numbs the itch-signaling nerves and reduces swelling at the same time!
20260430_0033_opt2: Prick it lightly with a needle
20260430_0033_opt3: Apply ice to cool and calm it
20260430_0034_key: What's an efficient way to cool down a hot pot of soup faster?
20260430_0034_answer: Transfer the soup to a wider, shallower container so more surface area is exposed to air. Fanning it speeds things up even more!
20260430_0034_opt2: Pour it into a wide, shallow container
20260430_0034_opt3: Place the pot straight in the freezer
20260430_0035_key: What's the best way to keep sliced bread fresh for a long time?
20260430_0035_answer: The fridge actually speeds up bread staling. Wrap individual slices in plastic and freeze — toasting them straight from the freezer works great!
20260430_0035_opt1: Store it in the fridge's vegetable drawer
20260430_0035_opt2: Leave it open at room temperature
20260430_0035_opt3: Wrap slices individually and freeze them
20260430_0035_opt4: Dry it out in the sun
20260430_0036_key: What's the safest way to manage passwords across many websites?
20260430_0036_answer: A password manager auto-generates and stores a strong, unique password for every site, so you only need to remember one master password!
20260430_0036_opt1: Use the same password on every site
20260430_0036_opt3: Save them as plain text in a notes file
20260430_0036_opt4: Stick a Post-it on your desk
20260430_0037_key: What does the small red number badge on top of an app icon typically indicate?
20260430_0037_answer: It usually shows the count of unread notifications or messages — like the red bubble on KakaoTalk or Mail!
20260430_0037_opt2: How much memory the app is using
20260430_0037_opt3: The current version number of the app
20260430_0037_opt4: How many days the app has been installed
20260430_0038_key: What's the safest thing to do when connecting to public Wi-Fi at a café or airport?
20260430_0038_answer: Turn on a VPN to encrypt your traffic, and avoid sensitive tasks like banking on public networks whenever possible!
20260430_0038_opt1: Turn on a VPN before using it
20260430_0038_opt2: Share files with other devices on the same network
20260430_0038_opt3: Choose networks with no password set
20260430_0039_key: What is it called when location data is automatically embedded into a photo you upload to social media?
20260430_0039_answer: A geotag stores GPS coordinates in the photo's metadata. It's smart to disable this when posting publicly to avoid revealing your home address!
20260430_0040_key: What's the first thing to try when a phone app suddenly slows down or freezes?
20260430_0040_answer: Force close the app and reopen it — it's the simplest, most effective first step. If that fails, try restarting the device!
20260430_0040_opt1: Factory reset the phone right away
20260430_0040_opt2: Force close the app and reopen it
20260430_0040_opt4: Remove the battery (even on sealed phones)
20260430_0041_key: Which British author wrote 'The Lord of the Rings' and 'The Hobbit'?
20260430_0041_answer: J.R.R. Tolkien was an Oxford professor and linguist. The Elvish tongues he invented are widely considered fully functional constructed languages!
20260430_0042_key: Which dystopian novel is famous for the line 'Big Brother is watching you'?
20260430_0042_answer: George Orwell's '1984,' published in 1949, remains one of the most influential novels about surveillance and authoritarianism!
20260430_0043_key: What is the name of the lion cub who is the main character in Disney's 'The Lion King'?
20260430_0043_answer: The hero is Simba, whose name means 'lion' in Swahili!
20260430_0044_key: Which school does the protagonist of the legendary basketball manga 'Slam Dunk' play for?
20260430_0044_answer: Hanamichi Sakuragi plays for the fictional Shohoku High School in Kanagawa Prefecture!
20260430_0045_key: In Pixar's 'Inside Out,' which emotion is represented by the red character?
20260430_0045_answer: Anger is the red character in 'Inside Out' — the film personifies five core emotions inside a young girl's mind!
20260430_0046_key: How many members are in the K-pop group BLACKPINK?
20260430_0046_answer: BLACKPINK is a four-member group: Jisoo, Jennie, Rosé, and Lisa, who debuted in 2016 under YG Entertainment!
20260430_0047_key: What is the medical name for the condition where you wake up but can't move your body?
20260430_0047_answer: Sleep paralysis happens when the brain wakes during REM sleep before the body's muscle 'lock' is released, leaving you briefly unable to move!
20260430_0048_key: What is the normal body temperature range for a healthy adult?
20260430_0048_answer: A normal underarm temperature sits between 36.5 °C and 37.5 °C, with small variations through the day and from person to person!
20260430_0049_key: Roughly what percentage of human blood is made up of plasma?
20260430_0049_answer: Plasma — the liquid portion — makes up about 55% of blood, with the remaining 45% being red and white blood cells and platelets!
20260430_0050_key: What is a normal resting heart rate for an adult, in beats per minute?
20260430_0050_answer: A typical resting heart rate is 60–100 bpm, though well-trained athletes can have rates of 50 bpm or even lower!
20260430_0051_key: Which food is famously rich in zinc, an important mineral for the immune system?
20260430_0051_answer: Oysters can pack 16+ mg of zinc per 100 g — by far the most among everyday foods. Sometimes they're called the 'milk of the sea'!
20260430_0052_key: What is the bias of sticking with a poor decision because you've already invested a lot in it?
20260430_0052_answer: The sunk cost fallacy makes us cling to lost investments instead of cutting our losses — it's also nicknamed the 'Concorde fallacy'!
20260430_0053_key: What is the psychological phenomenon of feeling like a fraud despite real accomplishments, attributing success to luck?
20260430_0053_answer: Imposter syndrome was first described by psychologist Pauline Clance in 1978 and is especially common among high achievers!
20260430_0054_key: What's the bias where one positive trait colors how we judge a person's other unrelated qualities?
20260430_0054_answer: The halo effect makes a single trait — like good looks — radiate over our judgments of intelligence, kindness, and more!
20260430_0055_key: What's the psychology term for forgetting your intention the moment you walk into another room?
20260430_0055_answer: The 'doorway effect' happens because moving to a new environment refreshes working memory, briefly erasing your last intention!
20260430_0056_key: What does the modern slang term 'FOMO' stand for?
20260430_0056_answer: FOMO stands for 'Fear Of Missing Out' — the anxious feeling that others are having more fun or success without you!
20260430_0057_key: Approximately how much has Earth's average temperature risen compared with pre-industrial levels?
20260430_0057_answer: Per the IPCC, global average temperature has risen by roughly 1.1–1.2 °C, and the Paris Agreement aims to keep the rise under 1.5 °C!
20260430_0058_answer: Carbon neutral means net-zero emissions — the amount of greenhouse gases released equals the amount removed from the atmosphere!
20260430_0058_opt2: Balancing emissions with absorption to net zero
20260430_0058_opt3: A policy that levies a carbon tax
20260430_0059_key: In which direction do typhoons rotate in the Northern Hemisphere?
20260430_0059_answer: Thanks to the Coriolis effect, Northern Hemisphere typhoons spin counterclockwise. South of the equator, they spin clockwise!
20260430_0059_opt3: In a straight line, no rotation
20260430_0060_key: Per unit mass, how does methane (CH₄) compare with carbon dioxide (CO₂) as a greenhouse gas?
20260430_0060_answer: Over 100 years, methane traps roughly 28–34 times more heat than the same mass of CO₂ — it's emitted in smaller amounts but punches far above its weight!
20260430_0061_key: Who originally created both the Linux operating system and the Git version control system?
20260430_0061_answer: Linus Torvalds released Linux in 1991 and Git in 2005 — both are now foundational pillars of the software industry!
20260430_0062_key: In which year was the first Apple iPhone released?
20260430_0062_answer: Steve Jobs unveiled the first iPhone on January 9, 2007, and it shipped on June 29, 2007!
20260430_0063_key: What's the name for a machine learning model that performs well on training data but poorly on new data?
20260430_0063_answer: Overfitting happens when a model memorizes noise in the training set and fails to generalize. Validation data helps detect it!
20260430_0064_key: What is the name of OpenAI's flagship text-to-image generation model?
20260430_0064_answer: DALL·E mashes up the surrealist Salvador Dalí with Pixar's WALL·E, and stunned the world by generating images from short text prompts!
20260430_0065_key: What does 'CPU' stand for in a computer?
20260430_0065_answer: CPU stands for Central Processing Unit, the 'brain' of the computer that executes instructions!
20260430_0066_key: Why does honey almost never spoil, even after thousands of years?
20260430_0066_answer: Honey's high sugar concentration and very low water content make it impossible for most microbes to survive. It's also slightly acidic and naturally antibacterial!
20260430_0066_opt2: Very high sugar and very low water
20260430_0066_opt4: Lack of oxygen at room temperature
20260430_0067_key: Which Italian city is considered the birthplace of modern pizza?
20260430_0067_answer: Naples is where the modern tomato-topped pizza took shape in the 18th century, and the famous Margherita pizza was created there in 1889!
20260430_0068_key: Which country is credited with inventing the original crescent-shaped pastry that became the croissant?
20260430_0068_answer: The croissant's ancestor — the kipferl — emerged in 17th-century Vienna, Austria, and only later traveled to France to be refined!
20260430_0069_key: What does the inside of a 'medium' steak typically look like?
20260430_0069_answer: A medium steak has a warm, pink center and a hint of juice, with an internal temperature around 60–63 °C!
20260430_0070_key: What is the biggest difference between white chocolate and regular chocolate?
20260430_0070_answer: White chocolate contains no cocoa solids (cocoa mass) — only cocoa butter, sugar, and milk — which is why it's pale and lacks a chocolatey aroma!
20260430_0070_opt2: It contains no cocoa solids (cocoa mass)
20260430_0071_key: Which set lists the three weapons used in Olympic fencing?
20260430_0071_answer: Olympic fencing has three disciplines: foil, épée, and sabre, each with different valid target areas and rules!
20260430_0072_key: How long is one round in standard professional boxing?
20260430_0072_answer: Pro boxing rounds are 3 minutes long with a 1-minute break in between. Amateur rounds are sometimes shorter!
20260430_0073_key: In baseball, what does 'hitting for the cycle' mean a player has done in a single game?
20260430_0073_answer: It means the batter recorded at least one single, double, triple, and home run in the same game — a rarity even in MLB!
20260430_0073_opt2: At least one single, double, triple, and home run
20260430_0073_opt4: Three steals plus one home run
20260430_0074_key: How far is the basketball free-throw line from a point directly below the rim?
20260430_0074_answer: Both the NBA and FIBA place the free-throw line 4.6 m (15 ft) from the backboard, parallel to it — a 1-point shot!
20260430_0075_key: Where does the marathon's official distance of 42.195 km come from?
20260430_0075_answer: It comes from the 1908 London Olympics' measured course between Windsor Castle and the White City Stadium, formalized by the IAAF in 1921!
20260430_0075_opt1: A distance from ancient Greek myth
20260430_0075_opt3: The width of the Marathon plain in Athens
20260430_0075_opt4: An arbitrary value chosen for timing convenience
20260430_0076_key: About how often does Halley's Comet swing close to Earth?
20260430_0076_answer: Halley's Comet returns roughly every 76 years. It last visited in 1986 and is expected back around 2061!
20260430_0077_key: How many constellations are officially recognized by the International Astronomical Union?
20260430_0077_answer: In 1928 the IAU divided the entire sky into 88 constellations. The 12 zodiac signs we know are just those along the ecliptic!
20260430_0078_key: How are the Milky Way and the Andromeda galaxy expected to move in the future?
20260430_0078_answer: They are approaching each other at about 110 km/s and are predicted to collide in roughly 4.5 billion years, eventually merging into a galaxy nicknamed 'Milkomeda'!
20260430_0078_opt2: They are moving toward each other
20260430_0078_opt3: They are moving in parallel paths
20260430_0078_opt4: They share the same rotation axis
20260430_0079_key: About how many years from now is the Sun expected to swell into a 'red giant'?
20260430_0079_answer: The Sun is about 4.6 billion years old, and in roughly 5 billion more years it will expand into a red giant, possibly engulfing Earth's orbit!
20260430_0080_key: How long does it take Pluto to orbit the Sun once?
20260430_0080_answer: Pluto takes about 248 Earth years to circle the Sun. Since its discovery in 1930, it hasn't even completed one orbit yet!
20260430_0081_key: What is the largest rodent species in the world?
20260430_0081_answer: The capybara, native to South America, can grow more than a meter long and is famously sociable, getting along with all kinds of animals!
20260430_0082_key: What color is a polar bear's actual skin under all that white fur?
20260430_0082_answer: Polar bears have black skin to absorb sunlight efficiently. Their hair is actually transparent, hollow tubes — not white at all!
20260430_0083_key: What do male Gentoo penguins famously give to a female they want to court?
20260430_0083_answer: Male Gentoo penguins search out the smoothest pebble they can find and present it as a gift — both nest material and a sign of affection!
20260430_0084_key: If a tiger were shaved completely bald, what pattern would appear on its skin?
20260430_0084_answer: Tigers have stripes on their skin too, not just their fur. The pigment is in the follicles, so the pattern shows up even where hair isn't growing!
20260430_0084_opt1: No pattern, a single solid color
20260430_0085_key: What color is the sticky 'sweat' that hippos secrete from their skin?
20260430_0085_answer: It starts off colorless but quickly turns reddish — acting as a natural sunscreen and antibacterial barrier for the hippo!
20260430_0086_key: Botanically, what kind of fruit is a banana?
20260430_0086_answer: Botanically, bananas qualify as berries. Strawberries, despite their name, do not — fruit naming is delightfully confusing!
20260430_0087_key: Who painted the ceiling fresco 'The Creation of Adam' in the Sistine Chapel?
20260430_0087_answer: Michelangelo painted the ceiling between 1508 and 1512, often lying on his back to do so. 'The Creation of Adam' became one of the most iconic images in art history!
20260430_0088_key: Who painted 'The Scream,' showing a figure clutching its face and screaming?
20260430_0088_answer: Edvard Munch was a Norwegian Expressionist painter. He created several versions of 'The Scream' from 1893 onward!
20260430_0089_key: Which two artists are credited with founding Cubism?
20260430_0089_answer: Cubism was launched around 1907 by Pablo Picasso and Georges Braque, who broke down subjects into multiple viewpoints all at once!
20260430_0090_key: Which famous ballet was composed by Tchaikovsky?
20260430_0090_answer: 'Swan Lake' is one of Tchaikovsky's signature ballets. He also composed 'The Nutcracker' and 'Sleeping Beauty'!
20260430_0091_key: In sheet music, what does 'forte' (f) tell the performer to do?
20260430_0091_answer: 'Forte' is Italian for 'loud' or 'strong.' Its opposite, 'piano' (p), tells you to play softly!
20260430_0092_key: How many writing systems are used together to write Japanese?
20260430_0092_answer: Japanese mixes three scripts: hiragana, katakana, and kanji. Katakana is mostly used for foreign loanwords!
20260430_0093_key: How many tones does Standard Mandarin Chinese have?
20260430_0093_answer: Mandarin uses four main tones plus a neutral tone. The same syllable can mean very different things depending on the tone!
20260430_0094_key: Where is Latin still used as an official language today?
20260430_0094_answer: Vatican City still uses Latin as one of its official languages — it's the working language of many Catholic Church documents!
20260430_0095_key: Which of these is the correct honorific (높임말) form of the Korean verb '있다' (to be / to exist)?
20260430_0095_answer: '계시다' is the special honorific form used for people. For inanimate things you'd use '있으시다' instead!
20260430_0096_key: Which 1939 English novel of about 50,000 words famously contains no letter 'e'?
20260430_0096_answer: Ernest Vincent Wright's 'Gadsby' is famous for being written without the letter 'e' — a writing constraint called a 'lipogram'!
20260430_0097_key: Inside which kind of animal do natural pearls usually form?
20260430_0097_answer: When a foreign object like a grain of sand enters an oyster (or other mollusk), the animal coats it in nacre, forming a pearl over time!
20260430_0098_key: On average, how many times per minute does an adult blink?
20260430_0098_answer: Adults usually blink about 15–20 times per minute. Each blink spreads a fresh tear film across the eye to keep it healthy!
20260430_0099_key: What is the purpose of the 'brace position' passengers are told to assume before a possible plane crash?
20260430_0099_answer: It curls the body forward to protect the head and neck and reduce secondary injuries from the impact, working alongside the seatbelt to improve survival odds!
20260430_0099_opt2: A position to protect the head and neck from impact
20260430_0099_opt3: A position to prevent motion sickness
20260430_0100_key: Which automaker first introduced the modern three-point seat belt as standard equipment?
20260430_0100_answer: Sweden's Volvo, with engineer Nils Bohlin's design, made the three-point seat belt standard in 1959 — and famously released the patent for free so other carmakers could adopt it!
